# Declared self-hosted workflow coverage. This file is structural input to
# tools/lint/check_verification_coverage.sh; it is not proof authority.
# Canonical admission comes from exact local receipts under receiving-node
# policy. Workflow jobs provide additional observations of accepted mainline
# bytes and consume no GitHub-hosted compute minutes.
#
# Format:
# item|self_hosted|job_key|display_name|attested_by
#
# `self_hosted=yes` requires a real job in .github/workflows/build.yml and `-`
# as attested_by. Every workflow job must be represented here. Environment-
# dependent skips remain explicit gaps in each suite receipt.

gcc|yes|compile-check|compile-check (gcc)|-
clang|yes|compile-check|compile-check (clang)|-
lint|yes|lint|lint (make lint)|-
fuzz-replay|yes|fuzz-replay|fuzz-replay (saved findings)|-
compile-all-tus|yes|build|build (cached dependencies)|-
tests|yes|tests|tests (make test-parallel)|-
arena|yes|arena|arena (make arena-demo)|-
